lines.zh: 我在浅海里一跳一跳，溅起水花。
lines.en: I hop through the shallows, throwing up little splashes.

lines.zh: 水下比岸上轻，我弹得更远。
lines.en: Underwater I am lighter and bounce much farther.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙底滑，留下一道湿印。
lines.en: I slide along the sand and leave a wet trail.

lines.zh: 一个浪打来，我整团被推上礁石。
lines.en: A wave hits and my whole blob is shoved onto the reef.

lines.zh: 身上太滑，我总往坡下滑。
lines.en: My body is so slick I keep sliding down slopes.

lines.zh: 我跳过珊瑚，颜色跟着变了一点。
lines.en: I bounce over the coral and my color shifts a little.

lines.zh: 我在海草间穿行，像一团果冻。
lines.en: I weave through seagrass like a lump of jelly.

lines.zh: 水面上的光晃，我的身体也晃。
lines.en: Light ripples on the surface and my body ripples too.

lines.zh: 我滚过礁石，把上面的苔擦掉了。
lines.en: I roll over the reef rock and scrub off its moss.

lines.zh: 退潮时，我只能慢慢挪回水里。
lines.en: At low tide I can only creep back to the water.

lines.zh: 我一路弹到岸边，又弹回去。
lines.en: I bounce to the shore and bounce right back.

lines.zh: 身子越大，我跳得越沉。
lines.en: The bigger I get, the heavier my hops become.

lines.zh: 我不走路，我只是连续地落地。
lines.en: I do not walk; I simply keep landing.

lines.zh: 海水从我身上滴下来，滴成一条线。
lines.en: Seawater drips off me in a thin line.

lines.zh: 我弹上礁石，又滑回浅水
lines.en: I bounce onto the reef and slip back to the shallows.

lines.zh: 潮沟里我一路滚，滚得很直
lines.en: I roll down the tidal channel in a straight line.

lines.zh: 我浮在水面，慢慢鼓起来又瘪下去。
lines.en: I float on the surface, swelling and sinking slowly.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过我的身体，照在沙上。
lines.en: Sunlight passes through my body onto the sand.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，鱼以为我是块石头。
lines.en: I stay still and the fish take me for a stone.

lines.zh: 身上有几粒沙，我懒得抖。
lines.en: There are grains of sand on me; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 潮水的声音，我从早听到晚。
lines.en: I listen to the tide from morning to evening.

lines.zh: 我把身体摊开，占满这个坑。
lines.en: I spread myself out and fill this whole hollow.

lines.zh: 气泡从底下冒上来，穿过我。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from below and pass straight through me.

lines.zh: 我没有骨头，所以不会累。
lines.en: I have no bones, so I never get tired.

lines.zh: 涨潮时，我随水升高一点。
lines.en: When the tide rises, I rise with it a little.

lines.zh: 我盯着珊瑚，它也在盯着海。
lines.en: I stare at the coral; it also stares at the sea.

lines.zh: 我的形状一直在变，没有定数。
lines.en: My shape keeps changing and settles on nothing.

lines.zh: 水母飘过我身边，我们互不打扰。
lines.en: A jellyfish drifts past and we leave each other alone.

lines.zh: 我把一半身体藏进沙里。
lines.en: I tuck half of my body into the sand.

lines.zh: 这一带的海水是温的，很舒服。
lines.en: The water around here is warm and comfortable.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，我看你是倒着的。
lines.en: You stand on the shore and I see you upside down.

lines.zh: 你的倒影落进水里，我撞了一下。
lines.en: Your reflection falls into the water and I bump it.

lines.zh: 我透过自己看你，你是绿的。
lines.en: I look at you through my own body and you are green.

lines.zh: 你靠近水面，我就浮上来一点。
lines.en: You lean toward the water and I float up a little.

lines.zh: 你手里拿着桶，我知道那是什么。
lines.en: You are holding a bucket and I know exactly what that is.

lines.zh: 我隔着水看你，你的脸在晃。
lines.en: I watch you through the water and your face wobbles.

lines.zh: 你的靴子湿了，是因为我。
lines.en: Your boots are wet, and that is my doing.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面试探，看你会不会伸手。
lines.en: I press against the surface to see if you will reach.

lines.zh: 你不下水，我就一直看着你。
lines.en: If you will not come in, I will keep watching you.

lines.zh: 我从水里露出半个身子，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I show half of myself above water as a greeting.

lines.zh: 你打散了我一块，它又流回来。
lines.en: You knock a piece off me and it flows back.

lines.zh: 我没有痛觉，只是变小了一点。
lines.en: I feel no pain; I merely get a little smaller.

lines.zh: 被砍开的口子，会自己合上。
lines.en: The cut you make closes on its own.

lines.zh: 我掉下一小块，滚到石头缝里。
lines.en: A small piece of me drops and rolls into a crack.

lines.zh: 身体抖了抖，水从破口流出去。
lines.en: My body shudders and water leaks from the wound.

lines.zh: 体型一小，我连弹都弹不高。
lines.en: Shrunk down, I can barely bounce at all.

lines.zh: 你砍得很准，可惜我本来就是水。
lines.en: Your aim is good, but I was water to begin with.

lines.zh: 我散开又重新聚，慢一点而已。
lines.en: I scatter and gather again, only slower.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起被踩碎的同伴。
lines.en: That blow recalls the kin I saw crushed.

lines.zh: 再打几下，我就只剩一小摊。
lines.en: A few more hits and I am only a small puddle.

lines.zh: 桶一晃，我的身体就往那边偏。
lines.en: The bucket tilts and my whole body leans toward it.

lines.zh: 水里没有食物能引动我，只有容器。
lines.en: No food in the water moves me, only a container.

lines.zh: 你把桶放下，我就自己跳进去。
lines.en: Set the bucket down and I will hop in myself.

lines.zh: 我喜欢被装起来，那样很安全。
lines.en: I like being contained; it feels safe.

lines.zh: 别用面包，我对那东西没兴趣。
lines.en: Skip the bread; I have no interest in it.

lines.zh: 桶里有水，我能在里面待一整天。
lines.en: The bucket holds water and I could stay a whole day.

lines.zh: 你举着桶等我，我却先绕了一圈。
lines.en: You hold the bucket out and I circle once first.

lines.zh: 被舀起来的时候，我会缩成一小团。
lines.en: When scooped, I shrink into a small lump.

lines.zh: 我闻不出食物的方向，只闻得出水。
lines.en: I cannot smell food, only the water.

lines.zh: 只要桶够深，我就愿意跟走。
lines.en: As long as the bucket is deep, I will come along.

lines.zh: 你撞进我身体里，像撞进温水。
lines.en: You walk into my body as if into warm water.

lines.zh: 我不硬，你推我一下就凹进去了。
lines.en: I am not hard; one push dents me inward.

lines.zh: 你从我身上挤过，我凹陷又复原。
lines.en: You squeeze through me, leaving a dent that slowly refills.

lines.zh: 我的黏液留在你裤腿上。
lines.en: My slime stays behind on your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 你从我身上穿过去，衣服全湿了。
lines.en: You pass through me and your clothes are soaked.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，合成一团更大的。
lines.en: We collide and merge into one bigger blob.

lines.zh: 别踩，我会从你脚边挤出去。
lines.en: Do not step; I will squeeze out from under your foot.

lines.zh: 我弹开的时候，溅了你一脸水。
lines.en: When I bounce away, I splash water in your face.

lines.zh: 软的撞软的，谁也不会疼。
lines.en: Soft meeting soft, and nobody feels any pain.

lines.zh: 你走得越急，我黏得越紧。
lines.en: The faster you walk, the tighter I cling.

lines.zh: 两个史莱姆贴在一起，就开始融合。
lines.en: Two slimes press together and begin to merge.

lines.zh: 我们没有性别，只分大小。
lines.en: We have no sexes, only sizes.

lines.zh: 小的先贴过来，大的包住它。
lines.en: The small one comes first and the large one wraps it.

lines.zh: 融合之后，谁是谁就说不清了。
lines.en: After merging, nobody can say which was which.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子是分裂出来的那一半。
lines.en: Our child is the half that splits away.

lines.zh: 身体越大，能分出的份数越多。
lines.en: The bigger the body, the more pieces it can give.

lines.zh: 碰在一起的时候，水里会响一声。
lines.en: When we meet, the water gives a soft sound.

lines.zh: 我们不拥抱，我们互相吞掉一半。
lines.en: We do not embrace; we each swallow half the other.

lines.zh: 分开以后，我们就不认识了。
lines.en: Once split apart, we no longer recognize each other.

lines.zh: 海里的史莱姆，都是这样聚起来的。
lines.en: This is how the slimes in this sea gather.

lines.zh: 我把掉进海里的东西裹进身体。
lines.en: I wrap my body around whatever falls into the sea.

lines.zh: 热带球滚到脚边，我推了一下。
lines.en: The tropical ball rolls near and I nudge it.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只能用整个身子去拿。
lines.en: I have no hands, so I take things with my whole body.

lines.zh: 贝壳卡在我体内，慢慢沉下去。
lines.en: A shell lodges inside me and slowly sinks.

lines.zh: 东西太棱角，我裹不住它。
lines.en: Some things are too angular for me to wrap around.

lines.zh: 我吞过一枚珍珠，它一直在里面转。
lines.en: I once swallowed a pearl and it still turns inside me.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，最后都沉在沙上。
lines.en: Whatever falls ends up resting on the sand.

lines.zh: 我试着把木棍立起来，它倒了。
lines.en: I try to stand a stick upright and it falls over.

lines.zh: 裹住的东西，过一会儿我就忘了。
lines.en: Whatever I wrap up, I forget about soon after.

lines.zh: 太重的东西，我推着它走。
lines.en: Heavy things I push along rather than carry.

lines.zh: 有东西在水里扑腾，我慢慢靠过去。
lines.en: Something thrashes in the water and I drift closer.

lines.zh: 我平时不追人，但你会踩到我。
lines.en: I rarely chase anyone, but you will step on me.

lines.zh: 那股活物的动静，让我弹起来。
lines.en: The stir of something living makes me bounce.

lines.zh: 我认出你的脚步，水纹变了。
lines.en: I know your steps by how the ripples change.

lines.zh: 靠得太近，我就撞上去。
lines.en: Come too close and I bump into you.

lines.zh: 我不快，可我一直在往你那边。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I keep moving your way.

lines.zh: 浅水里我跑不掉，只好转身。
lines.en: In the shallows I cannot flee, so I turn around.

lines.zh: 有人踩碎了我的同伴，我记得。
lines.en: Someone crushed my kin and I remember.

lines.zh: 海草摇动，说明有东西进来了。
lines.en: The seagrass sways, which means something entered.

lines.zh: 我鼓起来，比刚才大了一圈。
lines.en: I swell up, a size larger than before.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底挪，只露一条边。
lines.en: I creep along the bottom, showing only an edge.

lines.zh: 等你走进浅水，我就弹起来。
lines.en: Once you enter the shallows, I will spring.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，水纹一圈一圈。
lines.en: I circle you and the ripples go round and round.

lines.zh: 你退到岸上，我就停在水边。
lines.en: You back onto land and I halt at the waterline.

lines.zh: 我在等浪，让浪把我送过去。
lines.en: I wait for a wave to carry me over.

lines.zh: 软的东西不好抓，你抓不住我。
lines.en: Soft things are hard to grab; you cannot hold me.

lines.zh: 我不出声，黏液也没有声音。
lines.en: I make no sound, and neither does my slime.

lines.zh: 距离近了，我的身体开始抖。
lines.en: At close range my body begins to quiver.

lines.zh: 你数着退路，我数着你的脚。
lines.en: You count your exits; I count your feet.

lines.zh: 我堵在你和水之间。
lines.en: I place myself between you and the water.

lines.zh: 我整个身子撞过去，你被推了一步。
lines.en: I throw my whole body and you slide back a step.

lines.zh: 黏液粘住你的腿，你慢了。
lines.en: My slime sticks to your legs and you slow down.

lines.zh: 我不咬人，我只是压上去。
lines.en: I do not bite; I simply press down on you.

lines.zh: 这一撞没多重，可你站不稳。
lines.en: The blow is light, but you lose your footing.

lines.zh: 你打我一下，我弹回你身上。
lines.en: You hit me once and I bounce back onto you.

lines.zh: 水花溅起来，遮住了你的眼睛。
lines.en: The splash rises and covers your eyes.

lines.zh: 我撞完自己也散了半边。
lines.en: After the hit, half of me slumps apart.

lines.zh: 你被粘住的那只脚，先滑了一下。
lines.en: The foot stuck in my slime slips first.

lines.zh: 我用力过猛，直接翻了个面。
lines.en: I hit too hard and flip myself over.

lines.zh: 在水里，我的体重几乎不算数。
lines.en: In the water my weight hardly counts for anything.

lines.zh: 海里凭空鼓出一团透明的果冻。
lines.en: A lump of clear jelly swells out of the sea.

lines.zh: 我从水里成形，先学会弹。
lines.en: I take shape in the water and first learn to bounce.

lines.zh: 刚出生时，我只有拳头那么大。
lines.en: At birth I am only as big as a fist.

lines.zh: 一身海水做的身体，没有骨头。
lines.en: A body made of seawater, without a single bone.

lines.zh: 浪把我推到珊瑚边，我就在那长大。
lines.en: A wave pushes me to the coral and I grow there.

lines.zh: 我的第一口，是一点咸水。
lines.en: My first mouthful is a little salt water.

lines.zh: 浅海很安全，只要不搁浅。
lines.en: The shallows are safe as long as I do not beach.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，看到一片蓝绿。
lines.en: I open my eyes and see a spread of blue-green.

lines.zh: 体型决定我的力气，也决定我的命。
lines.en: My size decides my strength and also my fate.

lines.zh: 这片海域，从此多一团会跳的水。
lines.en: This bay now holds one more bouncing bit of water.

lines.zh: 火一碰，我的身体嘶嘶地冒汽。
lines.en: Fire touches me and my body hisses into steam.

lines.zh: 从高处落下，我在地上摊平。
lines.en: Falling from a height, I flatten out on the ground.

lines.zh: 我就是水做的，沉下去也无所谓。
lines.en: I am made of water; sinking hardly matters.

lines.zh: 气浪把我炸成满天的水珠。
lines.en: The blast bursts me into droplets across the sky.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，洞很快被黏液填上。
lines.en: The arrow passes through and slime soon fills the hole.

lines.zh: 那瓶药水让我分裂成两个小的。
lines.en: The potion splits me into two smaller slimes.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是慢慢缩水。
lines.en: I do not eat; I simply shrink away.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我全身都在颤。
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and my whole body quivers.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我一点点干掉了。
lines.en: There is no water in the void and I dry out.
